strings.zh: 要是你方便的话{NEWLINE}就把电话号码告诉给我吧！{SCROLL}这样下次想要对战的时候{NEWLINE}我回答电话给你的。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hey, can I get your number?{NEWLINE}I’ll ring you up to battle. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 想要对战的时候{NEWLINE}我会打电话给你的！
strings.en: I’ll ring you whenever I get the urge{NEWLINE}to battle!

strings.zh: 我知道了,不过⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我不想输在你手上！
strings.en: Oh, all right...{NEWLINE}But I won’t lose to you again!

strings.zh: 快把你电话号码告诉我！{SCROLL}我可不想老是输给你！{NEWLINE}下次再来对战吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Can I get your phone number?{SCROLL}I don’t want to lose against you!{NEWLINE}We have to battle again, OK? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 又输给你了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你真的很强啊！{SCROLL}不过,经常输{NEWLINE}反而感到心里很舒畅！{SCROLL}对了！这个给你吧！{NEWLINE}这下你就能变得更强,{CLEAR}当然,我也一样！{SCROLL}
strings.en: And yet another loss...{NEWLINE}No doubt about it--you’re tough.{SCROLL}Being beaten this often actually feels{NEWLINE}good now!{SCROLL}Here, take this.{NEWLINE}Use it to get even tougher. That will{CLEAR}toughen me up, too!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 喂,你好像就在附近啊,{NEWLINE}直接找我说话吧！
strings.en: Hey, you’re nearby, aren’t you? What’s{NEWLINE}with the phone call? Come talk to me!

strings.zh: 我那帅帅的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}你还记得吗？{CLEAR}我的{VAR:0100:10}{CLEAR}其他{VAR:0100:10}相比,{CLEAR}是完全不同的{VAR:0100:10},{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:10}中的{VAR:0100:10}。{SCROLL}你知道我在说什么吗？
strings.en: Remember my super-cool {VAR:0100:10}?{NEWLINE}My {VAR:0100:10} is totally different{CLEAR}from other {VAR:0100:10}. It’s a whole{CLEAR}different {VAR:0100:10}. It’s the{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:10} of all {VAR:0100:10}!{SCROLL}You know what I mean?
strings.notes: US 0675/7 | seed rejected us [tag_mismatch] (candidate US 0675#7; text not kept)

strings.zh: 前段时间我打败了{VAR:0100:11}！{NEWLINE}打得它满地找牙,{SCROLL}哎,没办法啊,{NEWLINE}谁叫我这么强呢！{SCROLL}下次再聊了！
strings.en: Oh yeah, I took down a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} the other day.{CLEAR}Beat it so bad it was spitting teeth!{SCROLL}Oh well, what can you do?{NEWLINE}I’m just that tough!{SCROLL}All right. Later!
strings.notes: US 0675/8 | tone review: 打得它满地找牙 kept as a violent brag (D-0627)

strings.zh: 前段时间我看到{VAR:0100:11}了！{NEWLINE}想要去抓的⋯⋯{CLEAR}可惜失败了！{SCROLL}哎,真是伤脑筋,{NEWLINE}谁叫我抓精灵{CLEAR}这么不熟练呢。
strings.en: Oh yeah, I saw a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}! I thought about{CLEAR}going for it, but then I failed!{SCROLL}Oh well. I guess that’s just{NEWLINE}the way it goes. I’m not very{CLEAR}good at catching Pokémon...

strings.zh: 我们来对战吧！{NEWLINE}这次不会再输了{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}到了附近就赶快来找我吧！{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: Let’s get together and battle!{NEWLINE}I promise things will be different!{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3}’s where I’ll be.{NEWLINE}Give me a shout when you come.{SCROLL}All right. Later!

strings.zh: 你真慢啊,{VAR:0103:0}{SCROLL}快来对战啊！{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: What’s keeping you, {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}Let’s get down and battle already!{NEWLINE}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 现在{VAR:0100:10}的技巧{NEWLINE}已经炉火纯青了！{SCROLL}如果你想来场漂亮的战斗,{NEWLINE}就再来一次对战吧！{SCROLL}再见了！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s moves are perfect now!{SCROLL}If you want to see a really great{NEWLINE}battle, come battle me again!{SCROLL}See ya!
